subject: 元北方城门守舍（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one standalone realistic Yuan northern-China map sprite. Original game reconstruction, not exact monument. Photoreal hand-made grey tile, buff earthen plaster, brown timber, stone; same restrained realistic detail density as Song map kit, no toy look. CRITICAL orthographic2:1 dimetric camera yaw45 pitch30; ground axes slopes+0.5/-0.5 precisely, all parallel edges remain parallel, verticals vertical, no perspective. Thin FLAT rectangular ground apron, visible LEFT/FRONT/RIGHT ground corners; no thick slab. Transparent RGBA background, whole object with 10% transparent margin, upper-left light and very short lower-right contact shadow. No text, lettering, people, animals, signs, flags, UI, watermark, modern objects, sky, scenery, checkerboard, Qing architecture, elaborate gold dragons. Subject: a tiny utilitarian Yuan northern city gate GUARDHOUSE, one-storey6x5m, NOT a gate tower. A squat two-room rectangular timber shelter under simple low gray gable roof, buff rammed-earth plaster infill and low gray brick foot, one stout board door and narrow square wooden barred window, one plain bench tucked under front eave. No weapons, flags, people or signs. No veranda pavilion ornate carvings, minimal turned-up eaves. Base6x5 means nearly square, left-front visible side6 units, front-right visible side5, ratio1.2. Clear flat four-corner ground stone apron; front-left and right base diagonals equal26.565deg to horizontal, orthographic ground slopes+0.5/-0.5. Reference gives material and sprite realism ONLY; make building shorter and deeper than reference.
